title: Sugar-Coating the Truth
description: Sugar-Coating the Truth — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: TDA Agent Anise Rawgers

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Find information on the next drop of smuggled Sweetener. The master of the Nether Crypts should have some information. Bring that information back to TDA Agent Anise Rawgers.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: TDA Agent Anise Rawgers

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Sweeten the Pot

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find information on the next drop of smuggled Sweetener. The master of the Nether Crypts should have some information. Bring that information back to TDA Agent Anise Rawgers.

Offer:

Mmmghmmgm mmmhfm mfmmm. *Cough* Excuse me, I should have chewed better. What!?

It looks like this Sweetener is a new form of Abysmal Candy being smuggled in from The Embercore Path. The TDA isn't sure who is running this smuggling operation, but it seems they are using the Mutants to bring the stuff into Balzack's Burrow.

We've been seeing an increase in use of the Sweetener and forbidden dancing from the monsters here. This smuggling operation is going to destabalize the whole dungeon! If the monsters all start dancing and using this sweetener, they could shake apart the dungeon walls. And I don't even want to think about what could happen if they started line dancing!

We need more information on the next drop of Smuggled Sweetener. TDA intel points to the Mutant leader in the Nether Crypts. Check him out and bring back any information you find to Anise Rawgers here in the Balzack's Burrow Base Camp.

Turn-in:

Great find, Dungeon Runner! Now if only we can decipher what this means. Here is your reward. Feel free to spend it while the TDA figures out what this message could mean.

Objectives:

  • Smuggling Drop Information ×1

Level range: 55–100
